payload.summary: The report that asked Cabinet for permission to consult. It is the same officer's report the Licensing committee saw six days earlier, re-presented to Cabinet: the same account of the law, the same four licensing objectives, the same licence counts, and the same note that a cumulative impact assessment is being considered separately. What it asks for is narrow — “That members authorise the revised draft Statement of Licensing Policy to commences public consultation” — and it proposes running that consultation “for 12 weeks from 11 May 2026 to 7 August 2026”.
